title: Y Combinator companies attacking cancer
method: Filtered the open YC directory dataset (6,209 companies) for oncology: pass 'keyword' matches cancer, oncology, tumour, chemo, radiotherapy, biopsy, leukaemia, lymphoma, melanoma, carcinoma, metastasis, malignancy, myeloma, glioma or sarcoma in the name, one-liner, description or tags; pass 'broad' matches wider terms (onco, carcinoma, precision medicine, liquid biopsy, CAR-T, radiopharmaceutical, immunotherapy, mammography, pathology, antibody, protein degradation, cell therapy, T cell) within the Healthcare industry. Every hit was then read on its YC profile and its website fetched on the checked date; a company is included when cancer is its stated primary work. Companies headquartered in mainland China or India are left to separate passes. matchedId is the OnCo company id.
